responsibility: Declares the incremental-compilation hashing module interface by re-exporting the stable hashing context and defining the shared list of attribute names that must be ignored when computing incremental compilation hashes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the dep-graph and query `mod.rs` files, this module is narrowly about incremental-compilation hashing semantics: it re-exports `StableHashingContext` and centralizes which attributes are ignored when computing stable hashes, instead of managing query execution or dependency nodes.
